description: Reads the exact shoppingListId returned by get_my_week or create_shopping_list. A week: reference reads app-week requirements with saved servings and current Pantry without saving anything; browser-only ticks, extras and serving overrides are unavailable. It supports read-only review proposals, not update_shopping_list or open_shop_handoff. Otherwise returns the latest saved revision of a shopping list: lines with stable IDs, which are ticked off (excluded) or partly covered, and the revision number that update_shopping_list and open_shop_handoff take. For supermarket searches use retailerTarget (the product, quantity and unit to buy after confirmed coverage). Keep the original name, quantity and unit for cooking. A missing target needs a stock or product check. Saved state here supersedes earlier conversation output. Lists expire after 24 hours; retrying an unavailable ID cannot recover it. Recovery creates a new list from the exact known intended menuDraftId, reopening its exact known savedWeekId first if needed. Missing exact references require the user to reopen the intended week; guessed IDs and recent-week substitutions cannot establish the intended plan. Rebuilding does not restore ticks or partial coverage. Read-only. Requires a linked Chop it account. For every live supermarket shop use Work. For a read-only current-week enquiry pass shoppingListId="current_week". For an explicit request to shop this week without a list, start with create_shopping_list({fromCurrentWeek:true}); use its owned list for the quick check and progress. For this/these displayed dinners, use their exact list reference. No screen needs to open. Before searching, pass the selected targets and retailer to get_shopping_profile for shelf search terms. Use ready matches directly after verifying their live title and size. For other lines call check_work_product_packs in batches with retailerTarget and observed listings. Leave a line unresolved if the checker or evidence is unavailable.

shoppingListId.description: The exact shopping list to read or update. Never infer the list from an old widget.
